decisions.decision: Frozen canonical BRRK directional research target; do not retune on the current historical window.
Portfolio line stopped after unacceptable drawdown and negative 2025+ economics; do not rescue through rank, hold, rebalance, liquidity or named-winner retuning on this sample.
Parameters frozen; forward shadow only. Historical extra sleeve is not production leverage authorization and should not be rescued on April 2024.
Rejected on the tested sample after crisis-alpha gate failure; do not retune to rescue the historical result.
All-perp Hyperliquid default rejected because funding-aware economics materially reduced BRRK CAGR on the common window.
BTC UI to HyperCore UBTC mapping publicly verified; this verifies instrument identity, not broad production authorization.
BTC spot-first remains an implementation/shadow candidate; unverified long exposures remain perp until separately validated.

Carry line stopped after corrected net economics versus risk-free cash failed. Do not rescue with asset removal, funding filters, basis thresholds, window changes, cost changes, weight changes or leverage.

BTC public Portfolio Margin feasibility remains a valid implementation observation but does not authorize live carry work.

Measurement-integrity implementation retained; live probe remains not required and not authorized.
Production long universe is BTC, ETH, SOL and BNB; additions require separate research and approval.
Primary venue is Hyperliquid; second venues are not default architecture and require a demonstrated capability gap or separate decision.
Leverage is model-determined; 70% drawdown is catastrophic tolerance only. Operating risk budget remains unfrozen until the dedicated leverage study.
Cycle exit is state-based, not calendar-based. FLAT means zero directional exposure and re-entry requires human approval.
BRRK four assets are the initial short benchmark; a future bear study may research sufficiently liquid contemporaneous Top-20 candidates, but this is not standing production authorization.
Bot uses trading Agent/API credentials only; master wallet private key, automated withdrawals and automated external transfers are outside the approved boundary.
Strategy upgrades use candidate/shadow development plus manual blue-green cutover; no hot strategy patching in ACTIVE.

Deterministic 128-bit Hyperliquid cloid is derived from release, canonical daily decision timestamp, asset, side, route-independent economic intent and executable target revision. Sequential replay/restart checks exchange orderStatus by cloid and suppresses a known order; this does not claim persistent local ledger, partial-fill retry semantics or cross-process locking.

Persistent single-account SQLite order ledger records deterministic CLOID intent before submission, a durable submission-attempt marker before the network call, submission/OID/status/fill/fee/average-price/remaining/cancel-reject truth, and restart reconciliation against Hyperliquid. Unknown or corrupt state fails closed and recovered exchange orders block new risk until resolved. This verifies P1.2 only; it does not authorize live production, complete the P1.3 partial-fill/retry lifecycle, or solve simultaneous multi-process/distributed locking.

Actual-fill-driven position progress is derived from reconciled fill quantity and order side, with explicit zero/partial/full fill state, live resting remainder, unfilled quantity, fill-implied actual position and target gap when a trustworthy pre-trade baseline exists. Quantity disagreement fails closed. Reversal-open deliberately does not invent a baseline before P1.4. This verifies P1.3 implementation only and authorizes no production trading or later roadmap capability.

Reversal execution separates old-direction reduction from new-direction opening. The close leg uses reduce-only semantics, and the new-direction leg is blocked until a fresh Hyperliquid clearinghouseState read proves the old-direction position is flat. Partial remainder, malformed/failed fresh state, or unexpected cross-through fail closed. This verifies P1.4 implementation only and authorizes no production trading or later roadmap capability.

Hyperliquid perp meta szDecimals now drives order-size formatting; size truncation uses Decimal/ROUND_DOWN, metadata errors fail before economic submission, and BTC/ETH/SOL/BNB pass independent formatting tests. A metadata-derived price formatter enforces the documented decimal/significant-figure constraints. This verifies P1.5 formatting only and does not authorize multi-asset production execution, P2 routing, or live risk.

Each trade-capable cycle now cross-checks Hyperliquid open orders, recent fills, actual positions, account equity and margin against persistent ledger truth and the current target. Unexplained differences become deterministic blocking reasons that prohibit opening, increasing or reversing directional exposure, while same-direction reductions and target-to-FLAT remain available when the durable ledger itself is usable. P1.2 LedgerUncertainState is carried into this risk gate instead of globally preventing reduction. This verifies P1.6 only and does not authorize production trading, P1.7 restart coverage or P1.8 emergency paths.
